about: AUTOEQUIP (Dom 2026-10-28, hero cleaver report): false = a boss kill still saves its weapon (unlocked) but the hero keeps the fight row weapon, the longsword with its guard; ?weapon=<unlocked id> still picks one, and the Frankendom menu will later. Progression and saving (Dom 2026-10-28: a weapon unlock per boss killed, a kill ladder, a save in localStorage, difficulty that escalates per kill). One row per boss, keyed by its data/profiles.json row id (the zone spawn `kind`; gargantua, arachne, pitborn = the Minotaur). `weapon`: the player weapon the FIRST kill of that boss unlocks (a src/fight/weapon-defs.json row, nothing new; reused from V1's rows and the weapon files already shipped); `name`: its HUD name ('Unlocked: <name>'). `healthStep` / `damageStep`: what EACH kill of that boss adds to every boss's health / damage multiplier (additive, so 3 kills at 0.06 is x1.18), laid over the boss as a ?tune= multiplier (src/tune.ts), so it rides the profile and difficulty rows and never replaces them; the sum is held at `healthCap` / `damageCap` (a multiplier on the boss's own value, 1 = no escalation). The rows are in boss order (Gargantua, Arachne, Minotaur: data/fight.json order). The unlocked weapon becomes the player's weapon on the next page load: the newest unlock the hero can draw (a weapon with an equip file, src/fight/scene.ts CARRIED_WEAPONS; the maul has none for the hero yet, so it is unlocked and shown but not drawn), or ?weapon=<id> for any weapon unlocked (the longsword is always his). The escalation applies from the next respawn or fight after the kill. The save is one localStorage key (`key`), versioned (`version`), read and written inside try/catch: a missing, blocked, corrupt or wrong-version save is a fresh game and nothing throws; no other key is read, written or removed. ?save=off (`query` / `off`) neither reads nor writes: the game exactly as it is with no save, for stills and tests. Only the zone loop (not ?postkill=v1's single fight) records kills. `lineSeconds`: how long the discreet HUD line stays.
